text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, October 11, 2022, Appeal DDRT2023-07.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Deferred consideration of Appeal DDRT2023-07 to the first meeting of the Tribunal to be scheduled in 2024. 2. Directed that the new hearing date be deemed peremptory to all parties. 3. Directed that the parties exchange a list of witnesses to be called by each party by no later than November 30, 2023. 4. Directed that the conditions of the Dangerous Dog Order (October 11, 2022) remain in effect.
